Data Ptr Pointer to received data. Length Length of the data in bytes. Parameters (inout) State Ptr Pointer to port/ data communication state. Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return Type E2E_ E_ INPUTERR_ NULL, E2E_ E_ OK, E2E_ E_ INPUTERR_ WRONG, For definitions for return values, see SWS_ E2E_00047. Description Checks the Data received using the E2E profile 11. This includes CRC calculation, handling of Counter. The function checks only one single data in one cycle, it does not determine/ compute the accumulated state of the communication link. Available via E2E.h
